title: DGLC_bundle: code and aggregate outputs for 'When Bias Lives in the Label: Diagnosing and Correcting Label-Resident Group Gaps, with a Graduate-Employability Case Study'
description: Code, configuration files, fixed seeds, and aggregate outputs that reproduce all results of the IEEE Access article (Access-2026-33868). Raw datasets are not redistributed; the README documents how to obtain AMEO 2015, Campus Recruitment (Kaggle), and ACSIncome (folktables) from their original sources.
